article.story: CHARLESTON, S.C. -- — Cade Norris had 19 points in Samford's 78-75 win over Citadel on Thursday. Norris shot 7 for 9, including 3 for 5 from beyond the arc for the Bulldogs (16-12, 9-6 Southern Conference). Jadin Booth and Zion Wilburn both scored 18 points. It was the sixth straight victory for the Bulldogs. Braxton Williams finished with 22 points for Citadel (9-19, 6-9). Sola Adebisi added 13 points, nine rebounds, five steals and two blocks for the Bulldogs. Christian Moore also had 12 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
